en: Color postcard showing a modernist high‑rise hotel with a geometric window facade and a rooftop sign reading HOTEL. A rounded annex at street level bears the words restaurant - bar. In front are 1970s streetlights, cars, and a bus, with trees lining the street. The reverse is printed in Romanian with postal fields and identifies the view as the Traian Hotel in Brăila.
